summary: End-to-end testing of the new /learn/:topic SEO landing pages (Option C hybrid). Backend GET /api/og/learn/{topic} verified for static + AI-cached topics, 404, and language fallback (7/7 pytest cases pass). Frontend verified on /learn/propagation (static), /learn/container-tomatoes (AI cache), and a non-existent topic fallback — including OG/Twitter/canonical head tags and the two-tier £5/£25 PaywallModal launched from the unlock CTA. All assertions pass; no issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: LearnLanding.jsx fetchLearnOgMeta error path treats every non-200 (incl. transient 5xx/network) as 404 'not found' — minor: could distinguish 404 vs network error so a flaky API doesn't show the 'topic not available' page.
Backend /api/og/learn/{topic} does no caching headers — adding Cache-Control: public, max-age=300 (or similar) would help social scrapers and reduce DB hits on viral shares.

Pure client-side OG via react-helmet-async means non-JS scrapers (some chat apps, older crawlers) won't see the dynamic OG tags. The implementation note mentions a future edge worker for SSR — worth tracking; default site-wide OG fallback in public/index.html mitigates this for now.
server.py is 2293 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; consider splitting masterclass/OG/paywall/plant endpoints into routers for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all assertions passed for the 3 routes + paywall modal)

test_credentials: Not required — passwordless flow; tests targeted the unpaid landing experience.
seed_data_creation: None — relied on existing static masterclass registry and the pre-existing container-tomatoes AI cache entry from iteration 11.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_og_learn.py covers GET /api/og/learn/{topic} for propagation, pest-control, plant-care, seasonal-planting, container-tomatoes (AI), language=fr fallback, and 404. Reusable as regression. Playwright covered learn-landing-{topic}, learn-title, learn-tagline, learn-intro-body, learn-paywall-cta, learn-unlock-btn, learn-not-found-back, plus head meta (og:title/description/url, twitter:card=summary_large_image, canonical). Paywall modal two-tier (£5 / £25) detected via body text. No fixes were applied — implementation is clean.
